meta.name: what-breaks
meta.description: Assess the impact of a proposed change on dependencies and shared infrastructure. Use before touching unfamiliar or consequential systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改代码前先看清会牵连哪些模块与共享组件,避免误伤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果即将改动陌生或关键系统,想先摸清连带影响
copy.tagline_en: See what a change will break across modules and shared pieces before you touch it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to change an unfamiliar system and want to know the blast radius first.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你动手改动前，先评估这项改动会影响哪些依赖和共享基础设施，如实报告未知项，并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。
howto.when: 当你准备改动不熟悉或后果重大的系统、想先弄清影响范围时，它会接管；若由 @fde 调用，则复用其现有已脱敏包与范围，不重新开始。

say.text: 我要改这个服务，先帮我评估会影响哪些依赖。
say.note: 它会列出受影响的依赖与共享设施。

say.text: 这次改动会不会影响其他团队在用的基础设施？
say.note: 它按依赖和共享设施梳理影响面。

say.text: @fde 已经在跑，接着评估这次改动的影响。
say.note: 它会复用现有已脱敏包和范围，不重来。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude assesses which dependencies and shared infrastructure a proposed change would affect before you touch unfamiliar or consequential systems, and reports unknowns honestly.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you are about to change an unfamiliar or consequential system and want the impact first; when called by @fde it reuses that existing sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: I want to change this service — assess what dependencies it affects.
say_en.note: It lists affected dependencies and shared infrastructure.

say_en.text: Will this change affect infrastructure other teams rely on?
say_en.note: It maps impact across dependencies and shared infrastructure.

say_en.text: @fde is already running — continue assessing this change's impact.
say_en.note: It reuses the existing sanitized packet and scope.
